note: Append-only hash chain: every entry carries prev_entry_sha = sha256(canonical(previous entry)); CORR-0000 (genesis) and CORR-0003 (end of the bootstrap prefix) are pinned in test_ledger.py. From CORR-0002 on, a case record is {prev_contract_sha, contract_sha} (retire: prev_contract_sha only) over the case CONTRACT (schema.contract_sha: everything but title / behaviours / provenance / notes); the latest record of every case equals its MANIFEST.json entry.

entries.finding: Codex review on 4e03152: P1-2, P1-3, P2-2 (+ Windows adversarial review)
entries.title: Contract hash replaces the expect-only hash; exact expectations; C13g engine divergences; observable trailing-entry case
adapters_changed: legacy_engine (applies_to: C13g known divergence in G-STOP-L-01, G-DAY-CAIRO-S-01, G-DAY-CAIRO-W-01)
entries.rationale: P1-2: the protected hash now covers the whole case contract (expect, applies_to, known_divergences and every causal input), not only expect; prev_contract_sha is null because no contract hash existed before (the CORR-0000/0001 records carry expect-only hashes). P2-2: no case-wide tolerance - expectations are exact (R and pnl to 1e-9; the engine journal adds its stated 4 dp resolution), path-step artefacts are per-trade tolerances naming the engine with a reason, and the C13g journal slippage is an explicit strict-xfail engine divergence instead of a 0.011 R tolerance. P1-3: G-TRAILENTRY-MAXPOS-01 redesigned so the first armed coin fills and closes while the second stays blocked (the old no-trade expectation passed with both signals ignored). Every known divergence names its ledger entry.
entries.evidence: branch aud-07-exec-truth on 4e03152 + this commit; mutation probes in the PR report

entries.finding: C13a (pyramid side, P2-4) / gap at the open on the target and safety-order side (P2-5)
entries.title: Pyramid-add slippage, take-profit gapped at the open, DCA safety orders gapped at the open
entries.rationale: Corrected causal expectations. legacy_backtest is a recorded strict-xfail divergence in all three (C13a: adds without slippage; TP gap: books the level, not the gapped open); legacy_engine is required. The DCA-gap probe difference (0.212 R vs 0.167 R) was the replay 8-step path overshooting the basket target, not a model gap.
entries.evidence: scratch gapprobe.py (Windows adversarial review) and the AUD-07 contract draft

entries.title: C11 fixed: time exit after exactly N candles in the backtest and the engine
adapters_changed: legacy_backtest (known divergence C11 resolved: G-TIME-L-01, G-TIME-L-02)
entries.rationale: Both models now count candles by index with the fill candle as candle 1 (floor(t/tf) - floor(t_fill/tf) >= N): backtest.py held N+1, engine.py counted wall-clock seconds and exited a candle late with a slower entry cycle.
entries.evidence: branch aud-07-product-r2 (merged with #32 r2 b01d439); reverting the item's product lines re-breaks exactly these pairs (mutation check in the build report)
